statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete. Five representative archetypes were selected; one detail request intermittently reset, which is recorded as evidence and a resilience finding rather than an unexecuted check. Not covered: account-authenticated states, destructive account actions, and exhaustive individual videos because they require credentials or duplicate audited templates.

paths.description: Homepage and primary video-discovery listing; represents the global header, cards, navigation, ads, and login overlays.
Representative video-detail journey selected from the homepage; navigation was attempted and encountered an intermittent connection reset.
Category/listing archetype, representing taxonomy browsing and dense list presentation.
Full-screen short-video interaction archetype, representing media playback, gesture navigation, and sticky advertising.
Published submit-a-video flow entry; it rendered the homepage rather than a submission form.

findings.summary: Ads interrupt and obscure the primary content on load.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots show a sticky ad covering roughly the bottom quarter of the shorts viewport and a large ad overlay on listing pages before user request.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not open ads over core content on load. Reserve non-overlapping ad slots and use a semantic, keyboard-accessible dialog only after an explicit action, with reliable light dismiss.

findings.summary: Custom ad and account overlays do not use semantic dismissible primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no dialog or popover elements while screenshots show overlays with custom close controls; the probe also found seven unnamed buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement first-party overlays with dialog/popover, accessible names, focus containment/restoration, Escape handling, and light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: The narrow layout overflows and disables user zoom.
findings.evidence: At a 360px visual viewport the layout primitive measured scrollWidth 390px, 30px horizontal overflow. Lighthouse also failed meta-viewport because maximum-scale=1 prevents meaningful zoom.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale=1, size the layout against the visual viewport, and use fluid intrinsic sizing so no component exceeds 100% inline-size.

findings.summary: Form controls, image alternatives, link names, contrast, and document structure fail accessibility checks.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility score was 0.74 and failed color-contrast, image-alt, label, link-name, listitem, and meta-viewport. DOM probing found 3 images without alt, 7 unnamed buttons, unlabeled search and checkbox controls, duplicate H1s, and many 19px-wide action selects.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control and link a discernible name, associate labels, fix list and heading semantics, provide meaningful alt text, restore zoom, enlarge targets, and raise text contrast to WCAG thresholds.

findings.summary: Load performance is poor and delivery is not prioritised for the initial viewport.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 6.8s, FCP 2.7s, Speed Index 8.0s, and performance 0.65; the trace independently measured LCP 6.21s and FCP 4.41s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP image, remove render-blocking dependencies from the critical path, and defer below-fold cards, ads, and media until needed.

findings.summary: The homepage transfers an excessive media and third-party payload.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 73 requests and 6.93MB transferred. A 4.17MB third-party MP4 dominated the load; total third-party transfer was 4.44MB. Lighthouse reported a 5,005KiB payload and 1,832KiB potential image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not preload or autoplay offscreen third-party media. Use poster images, lazy media loading after intent, responsive modern images, and explicit per-template byte budgets.

findings.summary: Essential defensive response headers are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirmed HTTPS but found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, a strict referrer policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; validate in report-only mode before enforcement.

findings.summary: Nine third-party origins load before consent, including analytics and adult ad networks.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 9 third-party origins and Google Tag Manager/Google Analytics; HAR attributed 4.44MB to third parties, including magsrv.com and pemsrv.com advertising infrastructure.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, delay non-essential analytics and ads until informed consent, proxy or self-host where appropriate, and document each recipient and retention purpose.

findings.summary: The published submit-video path does not expose its advertised primary flow.
findings.evidence: Navigating directly to /submit-a-video/ rendered the same homepage listing and no submission form, while the sitemap advertises the route as a distinct page.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the submission form at its published URL or remove the dead route. Preserve a clear title, requirements, progress, validation, success state, and recovery path.

findings.summary: Resource and platform hygiene issues remain in the production document.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices scored 0.77, reported unsized images and DevTools Inspector issues; the desktop screenshot visibly showed a broken logo asset, and two network resources ended in connection reset/abort.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide stable logo/image URLs with intrinsic dimensions, resolve Inspector issues, and make media failures fall back to durable poster/placeholder content.

findings.summary: The site language declaration does not match substantial mixed-language content.
findings.evidence: The document declares lang=es-DO, but navigation, titles, metadata, and calls to action visibly mix Spanish and English without per-fragment lang annotations.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose a consistent page locale, annotate foreign-language fragments with lang, and provide locale-specific routes and hreflang when serving both languages.

findings.summary: Ad presentation uses obstructive, visually dominant patterns that undermine user control.
findings.evidence: Screenshots show sexual-ad creatives layered over the requested content with small corner close buttons and no equally prominent privacy or preference control.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep ads clearly labelled and visually separate, make dismiss and privacy choices obvious and equivalent, and never disguise advertising as content or a primary action.

findings.summary: Authentication inputs do not provide complete browser autofill semantics.
findings.evidence: DOM probing found login and password-recovery inputs with empty autocomplete attributes; the username field was also unlabeled.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username, current-password, and email as appropriate, and provide persistent visible labels and accessible error messaging.

findings.summary: State changes and navigation are abrupt rather than using progressive transition cues.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across homepage, categories, and shorts found no View Transition usage; navigation is full-document and uncued.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions for listing-to-detail navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback and stable shared-element names.

findings.summary: Recovery for intermittent detail-page failures is left entirely to the browser.
findings.evidence: The representative detail URL returned ERR_CONNECTION_RESET during screenshot and DOM attempts, producing Chrome’s generic unreachable page with no site-level retry, cached shell, or alternate navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Stabilise origin delivery and provide a branded retry/offline response or cached shell for transient failures, preserving a route back to listings.

taskList.title: Remove obstructive ad overlays and restore user control
Fix labels, names, contrast, zoom, semantics, and target sizes
Cut initial media/third-party bytes and prioritise LCP
Deploy a defensive header policy and minimise pre-consent third parties
Restore the submit flow and resilient detail-page delivery
Repair asset/document hygiene and authentication autofill
Make locale and transition behavior consistent
